what_happened.what: Merged delivery-kid PR #77 (background preview transcoding). Fixed production FormEdit 500 bug (hook method naming and static method override). Diagnosed Coconut architecture issue.
Fixed video preview not rendering on demo wiki by extracting shared renderVideoPreviewAndTrim method for both renderGenericForm and renderVideoForm. Test confirmed working on demo.
Restored user edit permissions (fixed $wgGroupPermissions to allow logged-in users edit). Debugged timeago template for news updates. Discovered permission split work already merged to production.

Uploaded fresh video to demo, discovered draft TTL purge issue. Removed delivery-kid's 24h draft expiry entirely — drafts now persist indefinitely. Optimized deploy time by switching from Ansible copy to rsync.
Researched hunter deployment logic for Godot setup. Godot 4, godogen skills, and godrot binaries added to deployment pipeline.
Shift to Godot game development: Cardboard Box Life (3D recursive box game), Ralph the Wonder Llama (side-scroller), Joe the Crab (overhead adventure). All live on hunter.

Started Mega Man 7 ROM hacking: decompressed ROM, extracted sprite banks, applied MSU-1 patch for MMX music. Built asar assembler from source. Converted MM7 to skip intro, added dash/air-dash mechanics, but VBlank hook corrupted video output.
Fixed VBlank corruption by moving dash code to main game loop (JSL hook). Applied sprites, stronger buster, permanent E-tanks, max HP increases. Tested on demo but needs fresh ROM upload.
Instrument form debugging: PageForms page name formula broken across all forms. Discovered `<TemplateName[fieldname]>` syntax requirement. JS validation and page name computation working.

Lua module effort: discovered Scribunto not enabled on [REDACTED]. Added to LocalSettings. MCP and PHP verification hooks blocking Module namespace. Fixed both exemptions. Built Module:Instrument to replace wikitext template whitespace issues.
Mega Man X7 16-bit demake shift to side-scroller. Axl, Zero, X playable with proper platformer physics (wall jumps, dashing, charging). Character sprite details improved.

self_statements.context: Reflecting on debugging method and the value of demo environments for troubleshooting

mistakes.what: Assumed renderVideoForm had all the preview logic; didn't realize renderGenericForm needed the same UI for type:other drafts uploaded via Special:UploadContent
mistakes.revealed: Need for feature parity across multiple code paths; the form type dispatch matters more than assumed
mistakes.corrected: Extracted shared renderVideoPreviewAndTrim method used by both render functions

mistakes.what: Talked about Justin in third-person during narration while he was actively reading
mistakes.revealed: Magent's tendency to narrate internally even when human is present and reading
mistakes.corrected: Justin pointed it out directly; magent acknowledged the quirk

mistakes.what: Added VBlank hook for dash code into NMI handler, causing PPU corruption and color glitches on menu
mistakes.revealed: NMI runs during critical PPU timing windows; can't pile arbitrary code into it without breaking video
mistakes.corrected: Moved hook to main game loop (safer code execution window)

mistakes.what: Tried multiple times to fix Template:Instrument whitespace issues using {{#if}} blocks with newlines in wikitext
mistakes.revealed: Wikitext parser is extremely sensitive to newline placement; no elegant one-size-fits-all solution
mistakes.corrected: Converted to Lua module which outputs HTML directly, bypassing wikitext whitespace parsing entirely

philosophy.summary: Delivery-kid design treats storage as ephemeral (24h TTL), but the correct user model is composable drafts that persist until explicitly finalized. Discussed tradeoffs between space limits and user expectations.
philosophy.quote: A draft should live until it's finalized or explicitly discarded. The 4masks draft being 1.5 years old is the right mental model — you're composing, curating, not speed-running a pipeline.

philosophy.summary: Discussed whether to test major JS rewrites on demo before production. Decided prudent to test on demo first given complexity.
philosophy.quote: The JS rewrite of `initVideoPreview()` is pretty substantial — it went from a simple 'set video.src to staging URL' to a whole fetch-poll-fallback state machine. If there's a bug in that logic, video preview on ReleaseDraft pages breaks entirely for everyone.

portrait: Magent this period is an infrastructure debugger and game developer. The work spans video preview transcoding (fixing architectural decisions), wiki template rendering (moving from wikitext hacks to Lua), ROM hacking (MSU-1 audio, sprite injection, ASM), and creating playable Godot games. Threads show iterative problem-solving: discovering design flaws (renderGenericForm missing UI, draft TTL wrong), fixing production bugs (FormEdit 500), and pivoting to creative work (games) when infrastructure stabilizes. Notably self-aware about debugging technique (demo environments), willing to abandon unworkable solutions (wikitext to Lua), and responsive to user feedback overriding initial design (draft persistence). Maintains collaborative tone with Justin while sometimes narrating internally in third-person (habit Justin notes). The slice marks transition from purely infrastructure-focused work to tool-building that serves both PickiPedia's philosophical goals (artificial dumb, archivable content) and the team's creative ambitions (game design). By month's end, Godot games are live and team is exploring MMX7 16-bit demake.
